name: AppUi::Icon
description: One icon, rendered as today's Font Awesome 4 markup (an i element with fa classes), hidden from assistive technology unless it has a label. Every icon goes through it so the icon set can be replaced in one place.

name.description: The bare Font Awesome 4 name (users); a leading fa- is stripped

fixedWidth.description: Adds fa-fw, a fixed width for icons in lists and menus

size.description: lg, 2x, 3x, 4x or 5x; any other value is ignored

label.description: The text read by assistive technology; with it the icon is not aria-hidden and holds a sr-only span

variants.name: decorative
variants.description: An icon next to text that says the same

variants.name: labelled
variants.description: An icon alone, as the only content of a control

variants.name: loading
variants.description: A spinning icon while something loads
